description: Get aftermarket wheel upsize (plus-sizing) suggestions for a vehicle. Returns larger rim diameter options that maintain overall tyre diameter within acceptable tolerance. Key fitment terms returned: PCD (bolt pattern), offset (ET in mm), centre bore (CB in mm), section width, aspect ratio. Use this to recommend wheel upgrades while preserving speedometer accuracy.

region.description: Market code from list-regions (e.g., "usdm", "eudm"). Upstep suggestions are region-specific due to different OEM baseline specs. Key fitment terms: PCD (bolt pattern, e.g., 5x112), offset (ET value in mm), centre bore (CB in mm), tyre section width and aspect ratio.

name: wheel-upsteps
